DemoShowcase addon

This full admin page is registered in Frontend/sidebar.json and loaded as an iframe component.

What this demo shows

  • Widgets on dashboard, admin home, admin servers, server console, and files
  • Hide widgets via plugin settings (hide_dashboard_banner, hide_admin_card, hide_server_console_card)
  • Spell limits for the server sidebar page via plugin-sidebar-server-allowedOnlyOnSpells
  • Client + admin + server sidebar pages from one addon

Try it

  • Admin → Plugins → DemoShowcase → flip the hide toggles
  • Open a Survival / Creative demo server → look for Demo Showcase in the sidebar (spell-limited)
  • User dashboard → banner + card widgets at the top
